title: $768M in, almost nothing out
lede: Webvan raised about $393M privately and $375M at its IPO, then paid for HomeGrocer with more than a billion dollars of its own stock. Shareholders received nothing in the bankruptcy.

blocks.subtitle: Share of 296.8 million shares outstanding, Oct 20, 1999.
blocks.source: Prospectus, principal stockholders table[^1]. Directors and officers as a group held 60.5%, including the venture funds represented on the board.
